title.en: The Tempest (Charles Lamb's retelling of Shakespeare)

text.en: On a lonely island, a magician father raises a storm to bring his enemies to him.

Prospero and his daughter Miranda are the only inhabitants of an island. Prospero's books of magic have freed good spirits, such as Ariel, from the witch Sycorax, who had imprisoned them in trees. When Miranda sees a ship wrecked in a storm, she begs her father to have pity on the poor souls.
The storm was Prospero's own doing, to bring to the island the people who had once wronged him. The story moves towards forgiveness and reunion. It is a retelling of Shakespeare's play in simple prose.
Words to learn: tempest, spirits, magic, vessel and distress. Lamb's Tales from Shakespeare put plays into prose for young readers.
